candidate_id.description: Restrict to this candidate; omit for all candidates in the registry.

min_chain_score.description: Minimum chain_evidence.chain_score required for a sample's dosage to count toward the cluster.

min_band_fraction.description: Minimum fraction of windows inside the candidate span carrying a consistent window_band_call for the sample to receive a high-confidence call.

dosage_breaks.description: Decision thresholds on dosage; defaults split [0, 0.5)→0, [0.5, 1.5)→1, [1.5, ∞)→2.

confidence_floor.description: Calls below this confidence are dropped (not emitted).

method_tag.description: String written into karyotype_calls[].method for provenance.

candidate_registry.description: Promoted candidate intervals; one row per candidate_id with chrom/start/end and karyotype_axis.

chain_evidence.description: Per (sample × candidate × window) chain scores supporting the candidate; aggregates into chain_score per (sample, candidate).

dosage_summary.description: Per (sample, candidate) summarised dosage on the [0, 2] axis (mean / median per-window dosage inside the candidate span).

window_band_calls.description: Per (sample × window) discretised band label; used to compute the band_fraction inside the candidate span.
